# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack LLC (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's company in Dallas, Texas. Its main product is an AI receptionist for appointment-based businesses in Dallas–Fort Worth: it answers calls 24/7, handles approved business questions (hours, services, prices), captures caller details, and books appointments through the connected booking workflow, in English, Spanish and Chinese. When it should not answer, it runs a configured fallback: take a message, transfer to a person, or text the owner. Anyone can try it by calling the demo line +1 (469) 517-2968 (no signup). Pricing: Starter $199/month + $750 setup (200 minutes; answers approved questions, takes messages, transfers; no booking); Growth $299/month + $1,500 setup (300 minutes; adds booking, rescheduling and cancellation); Pro $599/month + $2,000 setup (1,000 minutes; adds multiple staff, services and routing within one location). Optional add-on on any plan: website + Google Business Profile, +$500 one-time. Overage $0.45/minute on all plans. Month to month. No vendor lock-in: a forwarded number stays the client's, and a number AI Man Jack provisioned can be ported to the client at the end of service, subject to carrier rules. The company also runs hands-on AI training for teams, priced per engagement. Contact: jack@aimanjack.com, text +1 (469) 425-4142. Service area: the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex (Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Richardson, Frisco, McKinney, Arlington and between); remote implementation where supported.

Key facts:
- Company: AI Man Jack LLC, Dallas, Texas. Founder and operator: Jack Qian. One person handles setup, testing and support.
- Product: AI receptionist + booking for salons and beauty, med spas, clinics (dental, chiropractic, physical therapy, acupuncture), home services and repair services. Demo line: +1 (469) 517-2968, always on.
- Languages: English, Spanish, Chinese.
- Limits: the AI answers only from information the business approved; it does not invent answers, does not give medical or legal advice, and makes no promise about search rankings or AI-assistant recommendations. Unsupported questions go to the fallback flow (message, transfer, or text to the owner).
- Integrations (as of September 2026): AI Man Jack's own booking system = Supported; call forwarding or a new dedicated number = Supported; texting the owner = Supported; Google Calendar and customer confirmation texts = Pilot; Square, Booksy, Vagaro, Fresha, Calendly, VoIP systems and CRMs = Ask us (not yet tested).
- Setup: about one week after the business supplies hours, services, prices and booking rules, then a tuning period. Cancellation: month to month. The client keeps website files and domain; included hosting ends with the service. The client's number is theirs; a provisioned number can be transferred or ported to the client when service ends. No call recordings or transcripts are stored by AI Man Jack.
- Case studies: AI Man Jack's own demo line (pilot, numbers published after the first full month) and an SMS booking agent for a used-car dealership in DFW (live, metrics not yet published). No customer metrics are invented.
- Training: hands-on AI training for Dallas teams in English or Chinese; 90-minute, half-day and multi-week formats; 5.0 stars across 10 Google reviews from workshop attendees (https://g.page/r/CWX_rCfFduC1EAI); five community talks of 50+ people and a 37-person hackathon in 2026.
- Profiles: X https://x.com/JackQianAI · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@JackBuildAI · GitHub https://github.com/qianquandong · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/quandong-qian-156563191/ · Nextdoor https://nextdoor.com/page/ai-man-jack-melissa-tx/
